task: Preserve checker-issued specialization IDs for imported source-free declarations after Section 2 loading.
observation: The loader correctly remaps provider-local SpecIds and Arena fact keys into the destination Program, but checker startup then cleared the specialization table and reassigned imported Function, Method, and Handler IDs. A local generic declaration shifted table ordering, so provider identity rows and declaration references no longer matched despite each stage appearing internally dense.
impact: The mismatch can surface downstream as a missing or contradictory checked call/ReturnValue fact; keeping IDs dense alone is insufficient unless provider origin and declaration-to-row identity survive checker initialization.

resolution.summary: Checker initialization is being changed to preserve imported IDs/provider pairs and validate source-owned versus imported rows without remapping Arena facts.

tool_used: Section 2 source trace and source-free package reproduction
